# source: LaTeX2e's standard classes (classes.dtx), the report class's sectioning: \chapter opens
# a page of its own under its word and number, and numbers the sections, equations and footnotes
# it holds within it; \chapter* heads one unnumbered. The rows probe the body of a report
# (the `class` place). An article has no \chapter, and the engine names it unknown there.
class impl \chapter{An invented title}
class impl \chapter*{An invented title}
class impl \chapter[Short]{An invented title}
